subject: Calibration: cross-functional rating handoff and borderline cases
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Calibration: cross-functional rating handoff and borderline cases

Team —

Thanks for jumping into calibration today. Attached is the working matrix (calibration-matrix-2026Q3.xlsx) with the consolidated recommended ratings from each manager. We have a brief window to finalize before comp letters go out next week. Key asks:

- Please review your rows and flag any candidate adjustments by 12:00p PT today.
- If you have people in the ‘borderline’ bucket (Delta ±0.5 from band median), call them out and include the principal evidence you plan to rely on (goals, peer feedback, production metrics).
- If you think a cross-team uplift/downgrade is warranted, note the rationale and the counterfactual we should consider.

A few constraints to remember: headcount budget is fixed for Q4, but we have limited discretionary stretch for promotion-related rating changes if there is strong evidence. HR will need a 1–2 sentence justification for any exceptions.

I’ve flagged two profiles already where we need leadership sign-off. Vivek — I left your team’s sheet unlocked for edits. Karthik — please attach your cross-team utilization numbers if you have them; they’ll help ground the normalization.

Attachments: calibration-matrix-2026Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp-guidelines-2026.pdf (policy)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calibration: cross-functional rating handoff and borderline cases

Laura —

On it. Quick notes after one pass through my team:

- Two borderline cases (A. Rishi, IC4; B. Naomi, IC3). Both are within 0.4 of band median. Rishi has strong client feedback and shipping velocity; Naomi has steady performance but weaker cross-functional impact. I recommend Rishi -> keep uplift, Naomi -> maintain current.
- For Rishi I’ll attach a short packet (OKRs, peer quotes, stack ranking excerpt) in a follow-up.
- Concern: if we push Rishi up without a corresponding normalization elsewhere we may create a ripple affecting promotions in adjacent pods. If Karthik’s utilization numbers show capacity slack in other teams, we could justify constrained uplift.

I’ll add inline comments in the spreadsheet. If anyone prefers a quick 15 to talk controversial ones, I’m available 10:30–11:00.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calibration: cross-functional rating handoff and borderline cases

Vivek / all —

I uploaded the utilization and impact adjustments to the same Drive folder (see link below). Quick summary: overall utilization across infra and platform teams is 2.7% under planned headcount capacity for Q4; that’s concentrated in two small pods (northstar & telemetry).

From a normalization perspective, I’d be comfortable supporting one selective uplift in your cluster if you can provide the qualitative evidence Laura asked for. That said, we should avoid a pattern of isolated raises without either rebalancing (promote + backfill) or formal exception sign-off.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-calibration-2026Q3

I added a short note next to Rishi’s row referencing client impact and two release milestones that justify an uplift. For Naomi I agree with maintaining her current rating pending stronger cross-team ownership next cycle.

—Karthik
Head of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calibration: cross-functional rating handoff and borderline cases

Folks —

I pulled the peer feedback excerpts and added them as comments in the matrix for both Rishi and Naomi. Also created a 1-page summary for Rishi (Rishi-packet.pdf). If we decide to uplift, HR will want the summary plus the peer/manager quotes.

On process: if Laura wants to mark the final exceptions, I suggest we route a one-line justification + supporting packet to the compensation committee inbox (comp-committee@redwood.ai) and cc the people ops lead for a final OK. I can do the routing if you want me to consolidate.

I’m available for the 10:30 slot if needed.

Attachments referenced: Rishi-packet.pdf (summary), peer-excerpts.txt (comments in sheet)

—Marissa Cole
Senior Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calibration: cross-functional rating handoff and borderline cases

Thanks everyone — good synchronous progress. Final action items:

1) Vivek: upload Rishi packet to the Drive folder and add the one-line exception justification in the spreadsheet by 16:00 PT today.
2) Marissa: consolidate peer excerpts into a single PDF and route package + one-line justification to comp-committee@redwood.ai; copy People Ops.
3) Karthik: confirm in a short reply whether the utilization numbers above are sufficient to approve a single uplift without additional backfill (yes/no).
4) Stephanie: update manager communications template with the calibrated rating language; final notes due EOD.

If we get those completed, People Ops will issue the final comp confirmations tomorrow morning. If any of you want to escalate to execs for an exception beyond the one uplift, ping me and I’ll arrange a 20-min slot with the COO.

Appreciate the quick turn —
Laura
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
